dispositions.adopted: Required in the local product; adoption is a design disposition, and verified behavior requires the current release evidence.
dispositions.context_dependent: Use only when the named condition and evidence justify it.
dispositions.deferred: Outside the present implementation; reconsider at its named trigger.
dispositions.not_applicable: Not selected for this design; the alternative and revisit trigger are explicit.

evidence_state: Normative decisions; current runtime behavior is verified through specs/implementation-evidence.json, not inferred from adoption.
id_policy: Append concepts; never reuse an existing ID for a different meaning.

concepts.name: KISS
concepts.rationale: Use one policy and one transaction owner; avoid universal CRUD machinery.
concepts.evidence: Review smallest complete command and dependency graph.
concepts.revisit: Another layer needs a concrete consumer.

concepts.name: DRY
concepts.rationale: Share business invariants, scope resolution and error mapping; similar syntax alone is insufficient.
concepts.evidence: Policy mutation affects all guarded operations in tests.
concepts.revisit: A rule diverges across entry points.

concepts.name: YAGNI
concepts.rationale: Exclude speculative adapters, inheritance and infrastructure from the current delivery.
concepts.evidence: Each component maps to an accepted requirement.
concepts.revisit: A measured operating constraint or accepted feature appears.

concepts.name: SOLID
concepts.rationale: Apply cohesive responsibilities and genuine external seams without mandatory class hierarchies.
concepts.evidence: Module ownership and dependency review.
concepts.revisit: A module gains unrelated responsibilities.

concepts.name: Single responsibility principle
concepts.rationale: Policy, transaction orchestration and transport mapping have distinct owners.
concepts.evidence: Routes delegate; domain imports no HTTP framework.
concepts.revisit: A change crosses unrelated responsibilities.

concepts.name: Open closed principle
concepts.rationale: Add provider adapters behind stable ports when a second variation is required.
concepts.evidence: New adapter passes the existing port contract.
concepts.revisit: A real second provider or delivery channel is accepted.

concepts.name: Liskov substitution principle
concepts.rationale: Local and actual identity/delivery adapters preserve the port contract and failure semantics.
concepts.evidence: Identical port scenarios run against adapters.
concepts.revisit: An adapter introduces weaker verification or silent success.

concepts.name: Interface segregation principle
concepts.rationale: Separate identity verification, delivery and publication contracts; no universal integration client.
concepts.evidence: Consumers require only their documented operations.
concepts.revisit: A consumer needs unrelated adapter methods.

concepts.name: Dependency inversion principle
concepts.rationale: Domain depends on policy/value contracts; infrastructure implements external ports.
concepts.evidence: Import boundary check and composition root review.
concepts.revisit: An ORM or provider SDK enters pure domain policy.

concepts.name: Clean Code
concepts.rationale: Use intention revealing names, small cohesive functions and explicit state effects.
concepts.evidence: Review names, nesting and responsibility with concrete examples.
concepts.revisit: A change becomes difficult to explain or isolate.

concepts.name: Fail Fast
concepts.rationale: Reject invalid configuration, unknown states and impossible scope before mutation.
concepts.evidence: Invalid environment and state leave persistence unchanged.
concepts.revisit: A dependency introduces delayed or ambiguous failure.

concepts.name: Defensive Programming
concepts.rationale: Validate inputs, authoritative state, adapter responses and time after lock waits.
concepts.evidence: Malformed input and fault injection cannot partially commit.
concepts.revisit: A new trust boundary or external response shape appears.

concepts.name: Explicit is better than implicit
concepts.rationale: Name actor, organization, version, clock and transaction instead of ambient authority.
concepts.evidence: Commands expose scope and version requirements.
concepts.revisit: A hidden default changes authorization meaning.

concepts.name: Cyclomatic complexity
concepts.rationale: Above 10 needs review; above 15 needs refactoring; above 20 blocks without bounded exception.
concepts.evidence: Complexity report and exact function exception register.
concepts.revisit: An exception reaches its next release expiry.

concepts.name: Cognitive complexity
concepts.rationale: Measure trends and inspect nesting; do not invent an objective baseline threshold.
concepts.evidence: Changed high complexity functions have a readability review.
concepts.revisit: A tool baseline or recurring comprehension defect is established.

concepts.name: Test coverage
concepts.rationale: Require risky branches and invariant scenarios rather than an arbitrary repository percentage.
concepts.evidence: Policy branch report and allow/deny scenario map.
concepts.revisit: A critical branch lacks independent verification.

concepts.name: Code duplication
concepts.rationale: Review duplicated rules and scope predicates; avoid extracting merely similar text.
concepts.evidence: Duplication findings classified as rule or incidental syntax.
concepts.revisit: A duplicated rule drifts or gains a third consumer.

concepts.name: Function class and module size
concepts.rationale: Track changed units and split incoherent responsibility; length alone is not a failure.
concepts.evidence: Size trends and owner review of large changed units.
concepts.revisit: A unit carries multiple reasons to change.

concepts.name: Coupling
concepts.rationale: Enforce module dependency direction and explicit external ports.
concepts.evidence: Import graph has no forbidden edge or cycle.
concepts.revisit: A new consumer requires a forbidden dependency.

concepts.name: Cohesion
concepts.rationale: Group identity, grants, publication and migration by their actual invariants.
concepts.evidence: Changes map to one documented domain responsibility.
concepts.revisit: An aggregate gains unrelated lifecycle or ownership.

concepts.name: Maintainability Index
concepts.rationale: Use as a comparative signal only after tool and baseline are fixed.
concepts.evidence: Recorded tool/version baseline; review trends without fabricated thresholds.
concepts.revisit: A stable baseline predicts maintenance difficulty.

concepts.name: Code smells
concepts.rationale: Review primitive authority flags, broad catches, hidden transactions and generic abstraction growth.
concepts.evidence: Actionable smell findings with owner and disposition.
concepts.revisit: The same smell causes an incident or repeated rework.

concepts.name: Technical debt ratio
concepts.rationale: Estimate remediation effort with uncertainty; no invented automated ratio or universal target.
concepts.evidence: Debt ledger records impact, effort range, owner and expiry.
concepts.revisit: Repeated debt changes lead time or risk materially.

concepts.name: Factory
concepts.rationale: Composition root selects configured identity/delivery adapters and rejects unsafe production choices.
concepts.evidence: Configuration matrix constructs only permitted adapters.
concepts.revisit: More runtime variants require richer construction.

concepts.name: Strategy
concepts.rationale: Use a callable for genuine locale/retry variation; keep one authorization predicate.
concepts.component: Catalog locale resolution and delivery retry classification
concepts.evidence: Each accepted strategy preserves the same behavior contract.
concepts.revisit: A second real algorithm is required.

concepts.name: Adapter
concepts.rationale: Isolate OIDC, delivery, catalog input and legacy source representations.
concepts.component: Identity, delivery, source and consuming product ports
concepts.evidence: Provider/source contract scenarios and failure mapping.
concepts.revisit: An external protocol or ownership boundary changes.

concepts.name: Repository
concepts.rationale: Use specific scoped queries; never introduce a generic repository framework.
concepts.component: Context specific adapters/postgres.py and scoped selectors
concepts.evidence: Repository SQL includes tenant scope and never commits.
concepts.revisit: A second persistence target makes the current seam inadequate.

concepts.name: Unit of Work
concepts.rationale: Use the native SQLAlchemy transaction owned by one application command.
concepts.component: Application transaction ports backed by native SQLAlchemy transactions
concepts.evidence: Grant, version, receipt and audit roll back together.
concepts.revisit: A use requires more than one transactional authority.

concepts.name: Dependency Injection
concepts.rationale: Use explicit constructors and native HTTP dependencies at composition boundaries.
concepts.component: bootstrap.py and HTTP boundary dependency composition
concepts.evidence: Tests replace ports without runtime global mutation.
concepts.revisit: A composition graph exceeds simple constructors.

concepts.name: Command
concepts.rationale: Represent grant, invitation and publication mutations with explicit scope and idempotency.
concepts.evidence: Bounded command schema, receipt and state effects.
concepts.revisit: New commands have different authority or atomicity needs.

concepts.name: Observer
concepts.rationale: In process listeners cannot durably own invitation delivery or authorization changes.
concepts.component: Postcommit delivery boundary; no in process critical listeners
concepts.evidence: Outbox owns postcommit delivery; no hidden listener side effect.
concepts.revisit: A noncritical subscriber has a measured isolated purpose.

concepts.name: Decorator
concepts.rationale: Instrument adapters and timing without concealing authorization or transaction ownership.
concepts.evidence: Wrapped and plain port behavior match under failure.
concepts.revisit: Cross cutting instrumentation repeats across adapters.

concepts.name: Facade
concepts.rationale: Expose bounded access commands to routes and consuming adapters.
concepts.component: Access application services and shared typed HTTP client
concepts.evidence: Consumers invoke the policy/use boundary rather than raw repositories.
concepts.revisit: Another consumer needs a stable application boundary.

concepts.name: Builder
concepts.rationale: Allow readable test fixture builders for coherent tenant graphs; avoid production fluent machinery.
concepts.component: Deterministic test fixture construction only when needed
concepts.evidence: Fixture builders reject invalid relationships and remain transparent.
concepts.revisit: Complex fixtures obscure scenario intent.

concepts.name: Specification
concepts.rationale: Express the access predicate as one explicit domain decision; no generic rule DSL.
concepts.evidence: Independent policy table proves each required condition.
concepts.revisit: Rules require approved composition beyond the existing predicate.

concepts.name: State Machine
concepts.rationale: Define invitation, membership, grant and migration transitions with guards.
concepts.component: Access, enrollment, catalog and migration transition rules
concepts.evidence: Invalid/repeated transitions cannot broaden access.
concepts.revisit: An accepted workflow introduces a new lifecycle state.

concepts.name: Template Method
concepts.rationale: Command differences are explicit functions and ports; an inherited workflow skeleton adds coupling.
concepts.component: Application service orchestration; no inherited skeleton
concepts.evidence: No subclass hierarchy hides locks or transaction steps.
concepts.revisit: Several stable workflows share a genuine invariant sequence.

concepts.name: Service Layer
concepts.rationale: Application services coordinate policy, locks, transaction and outputs; routes stay thin.
concepts.evidence: One owner commits each use and mutation.
concepts.revisit: A route begins owning domain or persistence rules.

concepts.name: Layered Architecture
concepts.rationale: Separate transport, application, domain and infrastructure with enforced dependency direction.
concepts.evidence: Import graph and thin route review.
concepts.revisit: A layer depends upward or becomes a generic dumping ground.

concepts.name: Clean Architecture
concepts.rationale: Keep pure authorization/state rules independent of framework and persistence details.
concepts.evidence: Domain tests run without HTTP or database.
concepts.revisit: Domain rules require infrastructure imports.

concepts.name: Hexagonal Architecture
concepts.rationale: Define ports at identity, delivery, legacy and consumption boundaries only.
concepts.evidence: Adapter contract suite covers success and failure.
concepts.revisit: Another external boundary needs isolation.

concepts.name: Onion Architecture
concepts.rationale: Another concentric layer vocabulary adds no enforcement beyond selected domain boundaries.
concepts.evidence: Existing dependency rules remain sufficient.
concepts.revisit: A concrete dependency requirement cannot fit the current model.

concepts.name: Domain Driven Design
concepts.rationale: Use precise access vocabulary, bounded modules and aggregate invariants without ceremonial classes.
concepts.evidence: Membership access version and scoped policy have named ownership.
concepts.revisit: A new domain has independent rules or lifecycle.

concepts.name: Microservices
concepts.rationale: Shared access transactions and a small team favor one deployable application.
concepts.evidence: ADR rejects splitting shared authority without evidence.
concepts.revisit: Independent team/deployment, isolation or measured scaling axis appears.

concepts.name: Modular Monolith
concepts.rationale: One application and PostgreSQL preserve atomic access transitions with explicit modules.
concepts.evidence: One image supports API/worker roles and module boundaries.
concepts.revisit: Measured organizational or operating needs justify separation.

concepts.name: Event Driven Architecture
concepts.rationale: Use durable postcommit outbox for delivery; current authorization remains synchronous database state.
concepts.evidence: Crash after commit cannot lose delivery intent.
concepts.revisit: Additional consumers need a versioned event contract.

concepts.name: CQRS
concepts.rationale: Separate command services from read selectors, keeping one database and model.
concepts.evidence: Read shapes are bounded and writes own invariants.
concepts.revisit: Measured query workload needs a separately derived read model.

concepts.name: Event Sourcing
concepts.rationale: Audit and command journal are evidence, not the source used to reconstruct all domain state.
concepts.evidence: Restore reconciles current decisions without pretending audit is complete event sourcing.
concepts.revisit: A domain explicitly requires event reconstruction and versioned replay.

concepts.name: Serverless Architecture
concepts.rationale: Database locks, pools and controlled workers fit the existing application deployment.
concepts.evidence: Deployment cost and connection budget review.
concepts.revisit: Measured burst economics justify bounded functions without harming authority.

concepts.name: Pipeline Architecture
concepts.rationale: Migration separates extract, parse, map, classify, compare and apply stages.
concepts.evidence: Replayable stage outputs and no permissive defaults.
concepts.revisit: A source transformation cannot be isolated or resumed.

concepts.name: Actor Model
concepts.rationale: Database serialization already defines access ordering; process actors would add another authority.
concepts.evidence: Cross connection tests prove ordering independent of process.
concepts.revisit: A new workload needs isolated state ownership beyond database transactions.

concepts.name: Workflow based Architecture Temporal Airflow Celery
concepts.rationale: Finite invitations and replayable migration use explicit state/outbox without an orchestration platform.
concepts.evidence: Recovery state is queryable and bounded.
concepts.revisit: Long running cross service compensation exceeds the current state model.

concepts.name: Horizontal scaling
concepts.rationale: Add stateless API replicas only within measured shared database and edge budgets.
concepts.evidence: Replica/pool/worker capacity worksheet and load rehearsal.
concepts.revisit: CPU or availability measurements justify another replica.

concepts.name: Vertical scaling
concepts.rationale: Increase database resources after query and lock analysis, not as a substitute for correctness.
concepts.evidence: Measured database utilization and cost comparison.
concepts.revisit: Resource saturation persists after query improvements.

concepts.name: Load balancing
concepts.rationale: Hosting edge distributes stateless API requests with bounded health based routing.
concepts.evidence: Health routing and replica failure rehearsal.
concepts.revisit: Multiple serving replicas or zero downtime demand appears.

concepts.name: Caching
concepts.rationale: Cache public/static metadata; do not cache positive access decisions in the first release.
concepts.evidence: Cache isolation and revocation tests.
concepts.revisit: Measured hot reads justify a versioned safe cache contract.

concepts.name: Database indexing
concepts.rationale: Index scoped joins, cursors, receipt lookup and outbox claims.
concepts.evidence: Representative query plans and write cost evidence.
concepts.revisit: Rows or workload distribution materially change.

concepts.name: Read replicas
concepts.rationale: Authorization, revocation and migration authority require current primary state.
concepts.evidence: Any proposed replica read is classified for stale state risk.
concepts.revisit: Measured nonauthoritative read pressure justifies lag tolerant replicas.

concepts.name: Partitioning
concepts.rationale: No measured table size or retention pressure currently justifies partition complexity.
concepts.evidence: Volume/retention baseline and maintenance cost review.
concepts.revisit: Audit/receipt retention or index maintenance exceeds budget.

concepts.name: Sharding
concepts.rationale: Cross scope relationships and one database remain manageable without distributed transactions.
concepts.evidence: Database saturation and tenant placement analysis.
concepts.revisit: A measured primary limit survives simpler scaling choices.

concepts.name: Queue based processing
concepts.rationale: PostgreSQL outbox provides bounded delivery intent without an external broker.
concepts.evidence: Duplicate delivery and worker crash recovery.
concepts.revisit: Delivery volume or independent consumers exceed measured capacity.

concepts.name: Async workers
concepts.rationale: Run bounded outbox consumers from the same application image.
concepts.evidence: Graceful shutdown, restart and claim/retry tests.
concepts.revisit: Worker contention or provider limits require changed concurrency.

concepts.name: Backpressure
concepts.rationale: Bound HTTP admission, database waits, report size and worker claim batches.
concepts.evidence: Overload rejects/degrades within tested resource budgets.
concepts.revisit: Queue age or pool waiting exceeds the agreed budget.

concepts.name: Rate limiting
concepts.rationale: Limit authentication, invitations and mutation abuse; shared deployment enforcement cannot rely on perprocess counters.
concepts.evidence: Two replica abuse rehearsal with no authority bypass.
concepts.revisit: Traffic pattern or hosting edge changes.

concepts.name: Circuit breaker
concepts.rationale: Protect delivery/provider calls when failures persist; a breaker never grants access.
concepts.evidence: Dependency failure rehearsal and recovery probes.
concepts.revisit: Repeated external failures waste the retry/resource budget.

concepts.name: Bulkhead
concepts.rationale: Separate API, migration and delivery concurrency/pools so slow work cannot consume all serving capacity.
concepts.evidence: Slow delivery and migration do not exhaust API allowance.
concepts.revisit: Shared resources violate the measured isolation budget.

concepts.name: Retry with exponential backoff
concepts.rationale: Retry only classified transient failures with jitter, attempts and overall deadline bounds.
concepts.evidence: Retry cannot duplicate transitions or bypass current authority.
concepts.revisit: Provider semantics or failure distribution changes.

concepts.name: Idempotency
concepts.rationale: Persist actor/scope/body/version bound receipts and stable delivery identifiers.
concepts.evidence: Lost response retry produces one durable transition.
concepts.revisit: A side effect lacks a stable deduplication boundary.

concepts.name: Timeouts
concepts.rationale: Use bounded request, lock, statement and adapter timeouts within an overall deadline.
concepts.evidence: Timeout hierarchy and rollback rehearsal.
concepts.revisit: Latency measurements or dependency limits change.

concepts.name: Dead letter queues
concepts.rationale: Terminal outbox failures use a restricted failed state and reviewed replay, not another service.
concepts.evidence: Poison payload stops retrying and remains inspectable without secrets.
concepts.revisit: Permanent failures require isolated retention or a broker.

concepts.name: Graceful degradation
concepts.rationale: Metadata panels may degrade; unknown authorization closes protected use.
concepts.evidence: Panel failure preserves safe independent workflows.
concepts.revisit: A fallback could affect protected access meaning.

concepts.name: Autoscaling
concepts.rationale: No unmeasured replica growth may multiply database connections.
concepts.evidence: Capacity limit and scale signal proposal.
concepts.revisit: Observed variability warrants bounded automatic scaling.

concepts.name: Stateless services
concepts.rationale: Keep sessions, grants, receipts and delivery state in durable shared storage.
concepts.evidence: Requests survive process replacement without authority loss.
concepts.revisit: New process local state changes request meaning.

concepts.name: Connection pooling
concepts.rationale: Budget all API/worker/migration pools below database headroom, including rollout overlap.
concepts.evidence: Pool budget worksheet and exhaustion rehearsal.
concepts.revisit: Replica count, rollout method or pool settings change.

concepts.name: Relational modeling
concepts.rationale: Model identity, membership, entitlement and grant as distinct scoped relations.
concepts.evidence: Schema relationships and multi organization negative probes.
concepts.revisit: A new relation changes access ownership.

concepts.name: Normalization and deliberate denormalization
concepts.rationale: Normalize authorization references; denormalize only measured read metadata with explicit derivation.
concepts.evidence: Canonical source and reconciliation for each derived field.
concepts.revisit: A measured query bottleneck justifies duplication.

concepts.name: Indexes
concepts.rationale: Align indexes with tenant filters, lock targets and stable cursor keys.
concepts.evidence: Plans on representative sizes and mutation cost.
concepts.revisit: Data skew or execution plans change.

concepts.name: Constraints
concepts.rationale: Use composite foreign keys, unique tuples and state checks beyond application validation.
concepts.evidence: Direct invalid SQL fails independently of services.
concepts.revisit: A critical invariant can move into a safe database constraint.

concepts.name: Transactions
concepts.rationale: Commit domain state, version, receipt and audit together under one owner.
concepts.evidence: Failure at every write point rolls the whole command back.
concepts.revisit: A new durable output crosses transactional authority.

concepts.name: Locking
concepts.rationale: Apply sorted resource then organization then membership/invitation locks; evaluate policy in a new statement.
concepts.evidence: Deterministic barriers prove ordering and bounded waits.
concepts.revisit: A new mutation or publisher path changes lock acquisition.

concepts.name: Isolation levels
concepts.rationale: Document READ COMMITTED snapshots and protocol assumptions; stronger isolation requires retry design.
concepts.evidence: Snapshot/interleaving suite includes waiting then fresh checks.
concepts.revisit: A new invariant is not protected by constraints and ordered locks.

concepts.name: Optimistic locking
concepts.rationale: Membership access_version and If-Match reject stale scoped edits.
concepts.evidence: Two editors cannot silently replace each other's changes.
concepts.revisit: Aggregate boundaries or pagination version behavior changes.

concepts.name: Pessimistic locking
concepts.rationale: Shared/exclusive organization locks serialize protected use with revoke.
concepts.evidence: Use before revoke may finish; use after revoke cannot commit.
concepts.revisit: A new protected output bypasses the lock protocol.

concepts.name: Query plans
concepts.rationale: Inspect actual scoped queries rather than assuming an index is useful.
concepts.evidence: EXPLAIN plans with bounded dataset/workload provenance.
concepts.revisit: Latency, estimates or row counts materially diverge.

concepts.name: Safe migrations
concepts.rationale: Expand/backfill/compare/fence/contract with ownership epochs and recoverable evidence.
concepts.evidence: Replayed backfill and postrevoke rollback rehearsal.
concepts.revisit: Schema or consumer compatibility changes.

concepts.name: Soft delete versus hard delete
concepts.rationale: Archive resources and revoke grants; retention deletion is a separately approved operation.
concepts.evidence: Archived/revoked rows cannot grant and references remain valid.
concepts.revisit: Approved retention requires irreversible deletion.

concepts.name: Audit
concepts.rationale: Write append only events in the command transaction with safe scoped fields.
concepts.evidence: Application cannot rewrite events; failed audit cancels mutation.
concepts.revisit: Recovery needs stronger independent immutable evidence.

concepts.name: Partitioning
concepts.rationale: Maintain simple tables until measured retention/maintenance pressure warrants partitions.
concepts.evidence: Measured size and retention plan.
concepts.revisit: Table maintenance exceeds the operating window.

concepts.name: Efficient pagination
concepts.rationale: Use bounded stable cursors; version grant pages and never replace an offpage set.
concepts.evidence: No duplicate/foreign rows or oversized assignment response.
concepts.revisit: Ordering or aggregate version semantics change.

concepts.name: Outbox pattern
concepts.rationale: Persist delivery intent with command state and send after commit.
concepts.evidence: Crash/retry tests preserve one intent and safe duplicate delivery.
concepts.revisit: Another external effect requires durable handoff.

concepts.name: Inbox pattern
concepts.rationale: No general inbound event bus exists; publisher receipts already deduplicate its command.
concepts.evidence: External key/version/fingerprint duplicate publication tests.
concepts.revisit: An event consumer needs event ID deduplication and ordering.

concepts.name: Idempotency keys
concepts.rationale: Scope receipts to actor, organization, operation, target, version and fingerprint.
concepts.evidence: Matching retry succeeds; altered fingerprint conflicts.
concepts.revisit: Receipt lifetime or command semantics changes.

concepts.name: REST
concepts.rationale: Expose scoped resources and explicit bounded transitions rather than a universal action endpoint.
concepts.evidence: Methods and paths match resource semantics.
concepts.revisit: A new operation lacks a clear resource or transition.

concepts.name: gRPC
concepts.rationale: Browser HTTP/OpenAPI serves current consumers without a second protocol.
concepts.evidence: Consumer and latency need documented before protocol expansion.
concepts.revisit: Internal consumers need measured streaming or contract advantages.

concepts.name: Versioning
concepts.rationale: Keep v1 meaning stable and record breaking changes with compatibility plans.
concepts.evidence: Generated contract diff classifies each change.
concepts.revisit: Authority or required inputs change incompatibly.

concepts.name: Pagination
concepts.rationale: Bound all collection and migration record responses.
concepts.evidence: Limit/cursor errors and maximum payload tests.
concepts.revisit: A new collection is introduced.

concepts.name: Filters
concepts.rationale: Validate closed filters and apply tenant policy before results/counts.
concepts.evidence: Invalid filters fail; foreign rows stay hidden.
concepts.revisit: A filter changes authorization or index shape.

concepts.name: Sorting
concepts.rationale: Use deterministic supported ordering and a stable tie breaker.
concepts.evidence: Tied rows paginate consistently.
concepts.revisit: New ordering or data distribution appears.

concepts.name: Idempotency key
concepts.rationale: Unsafe commands use persisted scoped receipts rather than client optimism.
concepts.evidence: Missing key, conflicting reuse and uncertain commit retry tests.
concepts.revisit: A new unsafe command enters the API.

concepts.name: Status codes
concepts.rationale: Differentiate validation, stale version, state conflict and concealed absence.
concepts.evidence: 422, 412, 409, 404 and 403 semantics are pinned.
concepts.revisit: A transition introduces a new recoverable failure.

concepts.name: Standard errors
concepts.rationale: One stable error envelope carries code, correlation and safe field details.
concepts.evidence: No SQL, tokens or hidden metadata leak.
concepts.revisit: A client needs a new typed recovery action.

concepts.name: OpenAPI
concepts.rationale: Canonical shapes generate client types and compare with implemented API.
concepts.evidence: Schema validation and generated contract compatibility.
concepts.revisit: Any HTTP shape changes.

concepts.name: Rate limiting
concepts.rationale: Bound caller abuse without leaking identities or retrying unsafe work blindly.
concepts.evidence: Rate response and Retry-After behavior under controlled load.
concepts.revisit: Hosting edge or consumer retry behavior changes.

concepts.name: Authentication
concepts.rationale: OIDC establishes validated identity through an opaque server session.
concepts.evidence: Actual provider positive and negative integration.
concepts.revisit: Issuer, claim or session policy changes.

concepts.name: Authorization
concepts.rationale: All reads, counts, writes, reports and migration review enforce current scoped authority.
concepts.evidence: Full endpoint policy matrix.
concepts.revisit: A new data path or machine authority appears.

concepts.name: Backward compatibility
concepts.rationale: Preserve supported consumer behavior through explicit adapters and writer fencing.
concepts.evidence: Old clients fail safely after retirement; target keeps revocations.
concepts.revisit: A consumer or ownership epoch changes.

concepts.name: Avoid generic POST action endpoints
concepts.rationale: Name domain resources and transitions with bounded schemas.
concepts.evidence: No catchall action/body router hides authority.
concepts.revisit: An accepted transition needs a dedicated endpoint.

concepts.name: Avoid state changing GET
concepts.rationale: Reads and invitation preview cannot mutate or consume tokens.
concepts.evidence: Repeated GET leaves domain state and audit transitions unchanged.
concepts.revisit: A preview acquires a side effect.

concepts.name: Avoid inconsistent responses
concepts.rationale: Use typed response envelopes and confirmed bounded mutation deltas.
concepts.evidence: Client generation and response tests.
concepts.revisit: A response changes shape across outcomes.

concepts.name: Avoid generic errors
concepts.rationale: Unexpected failures stay safe; expected failures retain stable recovery codes.
concepts.evidence: Client can distinguish retry, reauth, refresh and invalid input.
concepts.revisit: A failure cannot be acted on safely.

concepts.name: Avoid unbounded payloads
concepts.rationale: Bound grants, report references, pages and migration export batches.
concepts.evidence: Maximum shape and offpage preservation scenarios.
concepts.revisit: Data growth exceeds a documented bound.

concepts.name: Authentication
concepts.rationale: Validate identity separately from tenant access.
concepts.evidence: Issuer/signature/session negative scenarios.
concepts.revisit: Provider or session boundary changes.

concepts.name: Authorization
concepts.rationale: Deny by default and recheck every protected use under ordered locks.
concepts.evidence: Cross tenant and revoke/use matrix.
concepts.revisit: A new consumer or output appears.

concepts.name: OAuth2
concepts.rationale: Use authorization code with PKCE through the identity provider.
concepts.evidence: State, redirect and PKCE integration checks.
concepts.revisit: Provider or client type changes.

concepts.name: OIDC
concepts.rationale: Use immutable issuer/subject and verified recent email claims for invitations.
concepts.evidence: Nonce, audience, auth_time and freshness tests.
concepts.revisit: Provider claim or reauthentication behavior changes.

concepts.name: JWT
concepts.rationale: Validate provider JWTs server side; never invent browser bearer authority from decoded claims.
concepts.evidence: Wrong signature, issuer, audience and time are rejected.
concepts.revisit: Token validation or key rotation changes.

concepts.name: RBAC
concepts.rationale: Viewer/access_manager separates management authority from content consumption.
concepts.evidence: Manager without grant cannot consume.
concepts.revisit: A new role needs a reviewed permission boundary.

concepts.name: ABAC
concepts.rationale: Evaluate organization/project status, grant, entitlement and staff expiry as explicit attributes.
concepts.evidence: Each missing/expired attribute independently denies.
concepts.revisit: Policy attributes or clock semantics change.

concepts.name: Secrets management
concepts.rationale: Externalize issuer/client/delivery keys; isolate machine credentials and rotate them.
concepts.evidence: Secret scan, rotation and configuration validation.
concepts.revisit: Hosting secret store or privileged integration changes.

concepts.name: Least privilege
concepts.rationale: Separate application, publisher, operations and migration privileges.
concepts.evidence: Runtime cannot alter schema/audit or impersonate publisher.
concepts.revisit: A new database or machine consumer appears.

concepts.name: Input validation
concepts.rationale: Validate IDs, scope, versions, locale and bounded shapes before side effects.
concepts.evidence: Malformed and unknown fields cannot influence authority.
concepts.revisit: A new external input is accepted.

concepts.name: Output encoding
concepts.rationale: Escape translated metadata and treat provider/source text as untrusted.
concepts.evidence: Malicious title renders inert text.
concepts.revisit: Rich content or an export format is introduced.

concepts.name: SQL injection
concepts.rationale: Use parameterized SQL and allowlisted query shape choices.
concepts.evidence: Hostile input cannot alter SQL semantics.
concepts.revisit: Raw SQL or dynamic ordering is added.

concepts.name: SSRF
concepts.rationale: Allowlist issuer/discovery/delivery targets; callers cannot supply fetch destinations.
concepts.evidence: Arbitrary callback/discovery URLs are rejected.
concepts.revisit: A new outbound fetching capability appears.

concepts.name: XSS
concepts.rationale: Avoid executable metadata markup and browser stored credentials.
concepts.evidence: Hostile localized content and script payload tests.
concepts.revisit: Rich rendering or client storage changes.

concepts.name: CSRF
concepts.rationale: Protect unsafe cookie requests with origin and session bound token checks.
concepts.evidence: Missing/wrong token and foreign origin reject mutation.
concepts.revisit: Cookie or origin topology changes.

concepts.name: Rate limiting
concepts.rationale: Bound login/invite/mutation abuse with deployment shared enforcement.
concepts.evidence: Abuse cannot exhaust the complete pool or enumerate recipients.
concepts.revisit: Traffic or edge enforcement changes.

concepts.name: Audit logs
concepts.rationale: Record scoped actor/action/outcome without tokens or full sensitive payloads.
concepts.evidence: Audit atomicity, scope and redaction tests.
concepts.revisit: New privileged action or retention obligation appears.

concepts.name: Encryption at rest
concepts.rationale: Require deployment storage encryption and encrypted invitation delivery payloads.
concepts.evidence: Environment encryption/rotation evidence; no secret in dumps.
concepts.revisit: Storage/provider or retention policy changes.

concepts.name: Encryption in transit
concepts.rationale: Require TLS for browser/provider/delivery and production database links as configured.
concepts.evidence: Deployment connection and certificate checks.
concepts.revisit: Network topology changes.

concepts.name: Dependency scanning
concepts.rationale: Scan lockfiles and runtime images; adjudicate exposure with an owner and expiry.
concepts.evidence: Reproducible scan output and reviewed findings.
concepts.revisit: Dependency or base image changes.

concepts.name: SAST
concepts.rationale: Run static security checks with reviewed false positives, not a silent blanket suppression.
concepts.evidence: Security findings link to code and disposition.
concepts.revisit: New language/tool or threat boundary appears.

concepts.name: DAST
concepts.rationale: Exercise authentication, scope, injection and error concealment on an isolated running environment.
concepts.evidence: Authenticated scanner/probe evidence and reviewed findings.
concepts.revisit: A route or deployment boundary materially changes.

concepts.name: Supply chain security
concepts.rationale: Lock dependencies, pin build inputs, inspect artifacts and keep release provenance.
concepts.evidence: Artifact digest, dependency inventory and build record.
concepts.revisit: Build runner or publishing path changes.

concepts.name: OWASP Top 10
concepts.rationale: Use threat review to select applicable verification rather than declaring compliance.
concepts.evidence: Threat to control/evidence mapping for this product.
concepts.revisit: Threat model, exposure or supported inputs change.

concepts.name: Unit tests
concepts.rationale: Test pure policy/state predicates with independent allow/deny examples.
concepts.evidence: Every critical condition has positive, negative and boundary scenarios.
concepts.revisit: A domain invariant changes.

concepts.name: Integration tests
concepts.rationale: Prove constraints, locks, transaction effects and real adapters with independent connections.
concepts.evidence: Deterministic PostgreSQL interleavings and fault injection.
concepts.revisit: A persistence or concurrency path changes.

concepts.name: Contract tests
concepts.rationale: Pin external ports, HTTP schema and generated typed client compatibility.
concepts.evidence: Adapters and API pass the same accepted shapes.
concepts.revisit: A boundary contract changes.

concepts.name: E2E tests
concepts.rationale: Keep a few complete invitation/grant/use/revoke and tenant switch journeys.
concepts.evidence: Critical journeys run against the actual stack.
concepts.revisit: A new critical user journey appears.

concepts.name: Smoke tests
concepts.rationale: Verify build, migrations, readiness and an authorized/denied probe after deployment.
concepts.evidence: Cold startup and deployment smoke evidence.
concepts.revisit: Image or deployment shape changes.

concepts.name: Regression tests
concepts.rationale: Convert confirmed defects into focused behavior checks, preserving the failure trigger.
concepts.evidence: Each containment defect has a reproduction and regression.
concepts.revisit: A confirmed defect or incident occurs.

concepts.name: Load tests
concepts.rationale: Measure representative mixes, dataset and percentiles before selecting capacity objectives.
concepts.evidence: Repeatable workload, latency and saturation evidence.
concepts.revisit: Volume, topology or query plans change.

concepts.name: Stress tests
concepts.rationale: Find bounded overload/recovery behavior beyond expected demand without claiming infinite capacity.
concepts.evidence: Admission rejects safely and recovers within budget.
concepts.revisit: Expected burst profile or resource limits change.

concepts.name: Chaos tests
concepts.rationale: Start with controlled provider/database/worker fault injection in isolation.
concepts.evidence: Fault drills cannot expose or resurrect permissions.
concepts.revisit: A larger topology justifies broader fault experiments.

concepts.name: Security tests
concepts.rationale: Prove negative authority, identity, injection, origin and secret handling.
concepts.evidence: Authenticated threat probes and tenant matrix.
concepts.revisit: Threat model or trust boundary changes.

concepts.name: Snapshot tests
concepts.rationale: Use small stable protocol/presentation fixtures; avoid giant DOM or schema snapshots as authority.
concepts.evidence: Snapshot differences receive semantic review.
concepts.revisit: A stable output benefits from a bounded representation.

concepts.name: Mutation testing
concepts.rationale: Target pure critical policy guards with a bounded proposed 10 minute job; no arbitrary global score.
concepts.evidence: Seeded high risk guard mutations die; survivors and budget exhaustion are reviewed.
concepts.revisit: Policy changes, survived mutations or measured job cost change.

concepts.name: Structured logs
concepts.rationale: Record operation, safe actor/scope reference, outcome, dependency and duration; redact payload secrets.
concepts.evidence: Fault investigation joins safe structured events.
concepts.revisit: New sensitive field or failure mode appears.

concepts.name: Metrics
concepts.rationale: Measure request errors, latency, pool wait, lock wait, delivery lag and parity differences.
concepts.evidence: Metric definitions and controlled signal emission.
concepts.revisit: A risk lacks an actionable signal.

concepts.name: Distributed traces
concepts.rationale: Trace API, PostgreSQL, IdP and worker/delivery boundaries without leaking tokens.
concepts.evidence: One synthetic failed journey has connected spans and safe attributes.
concepts.revisit: A boundary lacks causal visibility or trace cost grows.

concepts.name: Correlation ID
concepts.rationale: Join command, receipt, audit, delivery and migration activity safely.
concepts.evidence: A retry retains operation linkage without authority leakage.
concepts.revisit: A new asynchronous handoff appears.

concepts.name: Request ID
concepts.rationale: Generate/validate perrequest identifiers and return them on safe errors.
concepts.evidence: Malformed incoming IDs cannot inject logs; errors retain safe ID.
concepts.revisit: Transport or logging changes.

concepts.name: Dashboards
concepts.rationale: Show health, authorization failures, outbox lag, contention and separate access gains/losses.
concepts.evidence: Synthetic incident is diagnosable from owner views.
concepts.revisit: An operating decision needs a missing panel.

concepts.name: Alerts
concepts.rationale: Page on actionable access mismatch or sustained failure with owner and runbook.
concepts.evidence: Synthetic alert reaches the approved test path and links recovery.
concepts.revisit: An alert is noisy, unactionable or misses an incident.

concepts.name: SLO
concepts.rationale: Propose availability/latency/access correctness objectives only from measured workload and business needs.
concepts.evidence: Owner approved SLO definitions and observation windows.
concepts.revisit: Baseline or business criticality changes.

concepts.name: SLA
concepts.rationale: Commercial commitments require Product approval and proven support capacity.
concepts.evidence: Explicitly state whether any SLA exists; no unsupported promise.
concepts.revisit: A contract requires a service commitment.

concepts.name: SLI
concepts.rationale: Define denominator, exclusions, success and latency scope before setting targets.
concepts.evidence: Metric queries reproduce the documented SLI.
concepts.revisit: Workflow or traffic accounting changes.

concepts.name: Error budget
concepts.rationale: Link reliability consumption to rollout pause and optional work priority.
concepts.evidence: Budget calculation and breach response rehearsal.
concepts.revisit: SLO or observation window changes.

concepts.name: Health checks
concepts.rationale: Expose minimal safe health signals, not secret configuration.
concepts.evidence: Responses reveal no configuration or private data.
concepts.revisit: New dependency changes health interpretation.

concepts.name: Readiness checks
concepts.rationale: Check bounded database/schema compatibility and reject unsafe identity configuration.
concepts.evidence: Unavailable database or incompatible schema removes readiness.
concepts.revisit: Serving dependency or schema version changes.

concepts.name: Liveness checks
concepts.rationale: Check process responsiveness independently from database/provider availability.
concepts.evidence: Provider outage does not create a restart loop.
concepts.revisit: Hosting probe behavior changes.

concepts.name: Business metrics
concepts.rationale: Measure verified onboarding, approval wait, grant changes and pilot access parity without PII labels.
concepts.evidence: Event timings separate processing from approval delay.
concepts.revisit: Product changes a workflow or success definition.

concepts.name: Profiling
concepts.rationale: Identify CPU, allocation, query and lock cost before optimizing.
concepts.component: Scoped queries and bounded external work
concepts.evidence: Profile workload/version/dataset provenance.
concepts.revisit: Latency or resource use exceeds the measured objective.

concepts.name: Benchmarking
concepts.rationale: Compare representative repeatable workloads with distributions and uncertainty.
concepts.component: Scoped queries and bounded external work
concepts.evidence: Baseline and changed run use matching inputs.
concepts.revisit: Implementation or topology materially changes.

concepts.name: Conscious caching
concepts.rationale: Cache metadata/assets with explicit invalidation; authorization stays current.
concepts.component: Scoped queries and bounded external work
concepts.evidence: Cache isolation and stale metadata behavior.
concepts.revisit: Measured repeated reads justify caching.

concepts.name: Avoid N+1 queries
concepts.rationale: Use bounded joins/selectors and assert query count is stable with page size.
concepts.component: Scoped queries and bounded external work
concepts.evidence: Small/large page query count and plans.
concepts.revisit: New list/detail data is added.

concepts.name: Pagination
concepts.rationale: Bound rows and response size before loading or serializing.
concepts.component: Scoped queries and bounded external work
concepts.evidence: Maximum page and cursor integrity tests.
concepts.revisit: A growing response becomes unbounded.

concepts.name: Lazy loading
concepts.rationale: Load resource detail/panels on demand; prohibit accidental ORM lazy N+1.
concepts.component: Scoped queries and bounded external work
concepts.evidence: Detail fetch is bounded and authorization rechecked.
concepts.revisit: Initial payload or query overhead becomes material.

concepts.name: Batch processing
concepts.rationale: Bound migration/export/outbox batches with checkpoints and resource budgets.
concepts.component: Scoped queries and bounded external work
concepts.evidence: Replay from checkpoint with no skipped/duplicated effect.
concepts.revisit: Data volume or batch contention changes.

concepts.name: Async I/O
concepts.rationale: Use supported nonblocking adapters with bounded concurrency; no blocking work on request loop.
concepts.component: Scoped queries and bounded external work
concepts.evidence: Slow dependencies do not stall unrelated requests.
concepts.revisit: New SDK or CPU work enters a request path.

concepts.name: Compression
concepts.rationale: Compress eligible responses/assets when measured CPU/bandwidth tradeoff is favorable.
concepts.component: Scoped queries and bounded external work
concepts.evidence: Size, latency and CPU comparison; secret responses assessed.
concepts.revisit: Payload distribution or edge behavior changes.

concepts.name: Connection pooling
concepts.rationale: Share bounded pools and measure wait instead of opening unbounded perrequest connections.
concepts.component: Scoped queries and bounded external work
concepts.evidence: Pool saturation and fail fast wait limits.
concepts.revisit: Deployment replica/process count changes.

concepts.name: Reduce external calls
concepts.rationale: Reuse safe provider discovery/key metadata; do not skip current authorization checks.
concepts.component: Scoped queries and bounded external work
concepts.evidence: Call count, key rotation and outage behavior.
concepts.revisit: Provider limits or rotation behavior changes.

concepts.name: Query optimization
concepts.rationale: Optimize actual plans and scoped joins without weakening filters.
concepts.component: Scoped queries and bounded external work
concepts.evidence: Before/after plan and correctness results.
concepts.revisit: A query becomes a measured bottleneck.

concepts.name: CDN for assets
concepts.rationale: Use hosting cache/CDN for fingerprinted static assets only when topology supports it.
concepts.component: Scoped queries and bounded external work
concepts.evidence: Asset version/cache invalidation and no protected content caching.
concepts.revisit: Geographic delivery latency warrants an edge layer.

concepts.name: Precomputation
concepts.rationale: No derived authorization model is needed before measured read pressure.
concepts.component: Scoped queries and bounded external work
concepts.evidence: Any future projection has authority/version/invalidation contracts.
concepts.revisit: Measured read workload justifies nonauthoritative derived views.

concepts.name: Background jobs
concepts.rationale: Move delivery and bounded migration/export work out of request paths while preserving policy fences.
concepts.component: Scoped queries and bounded external work
concepts.evidence: Worker restarts and current scope checks.
concepts.revisit: A newly slow operation needs a durable bounded job.

concepts.name: CI/CD
concepts.rationale: Use the same local gates in CI and promote a tested immutable artifact.
concepts.evidence: Revision, dependency locks, artifact digest and real gate results.
concepts.revisit: Build/deploy workflow changes.

concepts.name: GitFlow
concepts.rationale: Multiple long lived release branches add merge pressure to the current small team.
concepts.evidence: Trunk based changes and reversible release artifacts.
concepts.revisit: Several supported release lines require distinct maintenance.

concepts.name: Trunk based development
concepts.rationale: Use small reviewed branches and keep trunk releasable through enforced gates.
concepts.evidence: Protected merge checks and coherent change scope.
concepts.revisit: Branch lifetime or release contention grows.

concepts.name: Feature flags
concepts.rationale: Control presentation/rollout with owned expiring flags; ownership fence remains authoritative.
concepts.evidence: Flag rollback cannot reenable a stale writer.
concepts.revisit: Flag affects policy or outlives its removal date.

concepts.name: Blue green deployment
concepts.rationale: Use only if hosting capacity covers overlapping pools and both builds enforce target authority.
concepts.evidence: Compatible rollback and double capacity rehearsal.
concepts.revisit: Zero downtime requires an overlapping deployment.

concepts.name: Canary deployment
concepts.rationale: Roll out approved organization cohorts after shadow parity and writer fencing.
concepts.evidence: Cohort health, allowed/denied probes and stop trigger.
concepts.revisit: Risk or workload changes for the next cohort.

concepts.name: Safe rollback
concepts.rationale: Return to compatible application code while retaining target state and revocations.
concepts.evidence: Postrevoke rollback plus unavailable compatible build drill.
concepts.revisit: A schema or authority change affects rollback eligibility.

concepts.name: Infrastructure as Code
concepts.rationale: Version local topology now; define production resources once hosting ownership is known.
concepts.evidence: Reviewed environment diff and reproducible provisioning.
concepts.revisit: Production hosting target is confirmed or changes.

concepts.name: Docker
concepts.rationale: Provide reproducible images and local database/provider topology with minimal runtime privileges.
concepts.evidence: Cold build/startup and nonroot configuration evidence.
concepts.revisit: Base image, runtime or local topology changes.

concepts.name: Kubernetes
concepts.rationale: Current topology does not require a cluster control plane.
concepts.evidence: Hosting/deployment constraints recorded without pretending cluster support.
concepts.revisit: Existing platform or measured operating requirements justify it.

concepts.name: Helm
concepts.rationale: No selected Kubernetes deployment exists to template.
concepts.evidence: No unused chart or unverified deployment claim.
concepts.revisit: A reviewed Kubernetes target requires packaging.

concepts.name: Terraform
concepts.rationale: Select only when the chosen hosting resources benefit from its supported lifecycle.
concepts.evidence: Provider/state ownership and reproducible plan review.
concepts.revisit: Production infrastructure target is selected.

concepts.name: External secrets
concepts.rationale: Provision runtime keys outside Git/images with rotation and least privilege.
concepts.evidence: Secret injection, redaction and rotation rehearsal.
concepts.revisit: Hosting secret mechanism changes.

concepts.name: Consistent environments
concepts.rationale: Use the same schemas/config validation with explicit local identity exceptions.
concepts.evidence: Local/test/pilot configuration matrix.
concepts.revisit: An environment adds divergent behavior.

concepts.name: Reproducible builds
concepts.rationale: Commit lockfiles and pin image inputs; promote the exact tested artifact.
concepts.evidence: Fresh install/build and artifact provenance.
concepts.revisit: Dependency or build input changes.

concepts.name: Semantic versioning
concepts.rationale: Version releases and contracts by compatibility meaning with accurate release notes.
concepts.evidence: Breaking/additive/fix classification matches published contract.
concepts.revisit: Authority or compatibility semantics change.

concepts.name: Is it simple
concepts.rationale: Ask which accepted requirement each layer or abstraction serves.
concepts.evidence: Reviewer identifies unnecessary components and records the cut.
concepts.revisit: A design adds infrastructure or indirection.

concepts.name: Does it solve the real problem
concepts.rationale: Trace work to scoped access, onboarding or verified operating risk.
concepts.evidence: Requirement to behavior/evidence mapping.
concepts.revisit: Scope or Product priority changes.

concepts.name: Does it scale
concepts.rationale: Review workload, pool budget, lock contention and growth triggers.
concepts.evidence: Capacity worksheet and overload rehearsal.
concepts.revisit: Traffic, tenant skew or data volume changes.

concepts.name: Is it observable
concepts.rationale: Trace one failed journey from user outcome to dependency and persisted state.
concepts.evidence: Synthetic investigation with linked safe telemetry.
concepts.revisit: A new failure lacks a useful signal.

concepts.name: Is it secure
concepts.rationale: Review trust boundaries, minimum authority and negative data paths.
concepts.evidence: Threat matrix and actual identity integration.
concepts.revisit: New privilege or external input appears.

concepts.name: Is it testable
concepts.rationale: Expose independent domain predicates and deterministic transaction barriers.
concepts.evidence: Critical invariant can fail under an independent scenario.
concepts.revisit: Tests mirror implementation instead of behavior.

concepts.name: Is it maintainable
concepts.rationale: Review cohesion, names, debt ownership and change impact.
concepts.evidence: Import/complexity/debt findings have dispositions.
concepts.revisit: Maintenance effort or comprehension regressions grow.

concepts.name: Is it reversible
concepts.rationale: Preserve target authority and current revocations; legacy authority rollback is excluded.
concepts.evidence: Rollback/repair forward decision and rehearsal.
concepts.revisit: A destructive or authority transition is proposed.

concepts.name: Does it create unnecessary dependency
concepts.rationale: Require a boundary benefit and owner for each package/service.
concepts.evidence: Dependency inventory maps to accepted functions.
concepts.revisit: A new runtime dependency is proposed.

concepts.name: Is it too coupled
concepts.rationale: Keep rules and infrastructure independent and one transaction owner explicit.
concepts.evidence: No forbidden imports or hidden crossmodule writes.
concepts.revisit: A change requires unrelated modules to move together.

concepts.name: ADR
concepts.rationale: Record accepted choices, alternatives, consequences and revisit trigger.
concepts.evidence: Decision links to affected contracts and implementation evidence.
concepts.revisit: An architectural choice or authority boundary changes.

concepts.name: RFC
concepts.rationale: Use a proposal for wide or difficult reversals, not every local edit.
concepts.evidence: Affected owners review options before contract changes.
concepts.revisit: A change spans modules or introduces new infrastructure.

concepts.name: Trade off analysis
concepts.rationale: Compare correctness, operability, delivery effort and ongoing cost with assumptions.
concepts.evidence: Decision includes a realistic simpler alternative.
concepts.revisit: Evidence changes the balance of costs or constraints.

concepts.name: Risk assessment
concepts.rationale: Name impact, trigger, mitigation, owner and stop/recovery condition.
concepts.evidence: Risk register is reviewed at release and cutover.
concepts.revisit: Threat, dependency or cohort risk changes.

concepts.name: Proof of Concept
concepts.rationale: Use a bounded throwaway proof for an uncertain integration or mechanism.
concepts.evidence: Question, experiment, outcome and discard/productionize decision.
concepts.revisit: A high consequence technical assumption lacks evidence.

concepts.name: Technical spike
concepts.rationale: Timebox lock/provider/migration uncertainty with explicit next decision.
concepts.evidence: Hypothesis, reproducible probe and recorded outcome.
concepts.revisit: A dependency or concurrency assumption remains uncertain.

concepts.name: Design review
concepts.rationale: Review access, concurrency, migration and operations with an independent engineer.
concepts.evidence: Actionable findings resolved or owned before release.
concepts.revisit: A material invariant or deployment shape changes.

concepts.name: Blameless postmortem
concepts.rationale: Explain contributing conditions and improve system controls without assigning personal blame.
concepts.evidence: Incident timeline, impact and owned corrective actions.
concepts.revisit: A significant incident or near miss occurs.

concepts.name: Which problem and why now
concepts.rationale: Prioritize verified access failures and measurable risks before optional sophistication.
concepts.evidence: Change states trigger, intended outcome and alternatives.
concepts.revisit: A new request competes for limited capacity.

concepts.name: Clear business rules
concepts.rationale: Explicitly approve continuity and no-revival rules; unresolved cohorts receive no broad default permission.
concepts.component: Complete public product and live gates
concepts.evidence: Approved rule and explicit blocked exceptions.
concepts.revisit: Product changes entitlement or approval policy.

concepts.name: Separated domain
concepts.rationale: Identity, organization, entitlement and grant retain independent meaning.
concepts.component: Complete public product and live gates
concepts.evidence: Predicate and state boundaries have independent tests.
concepts.revisit: A new domain changes ownership.

concepts.name: Tests
concepts.rationale: Critical risk scenarios have real implementation evidence at the applicable layer.
concepts.component: Complete public product and live gates
concepts.evidence: Evidence map covers every required scenario.
concepts.revisit: Behavior or environment changes.

concepts.name: Logs
concepts.rationale: Failures identify operation/outcome/dependency safely without full payload leakage.
concepts.component: Complete public product and live gates
concepts.evidence: Redacted synthetic investigation.
concepts.revisit: A new sensitive field or failure appears.

concepts.name: Metrics
concepts.rationale: Operational and business signals have definitions and bounded label cardinality.
concepts.component: Complete public product and live gates
concepts.evidence: Signal emission and definition review.
concepts.revisit: A decision lacks a useful measured signal.

concepts.name: Trace
concepts.rationale: Connect request, database and delivery/provider work within the accepted telemetry budget.
concepts.component: Complete public product and live gates
concepts.evidence: Failed journey trace links safe spans.
concepts.revisit: Boundary coverage or telemetry cost changes.

concepts.name: Rollback
concepts.rationale: Rehearsal preserves target authority, current grants and later revocations.
concepts.component: Complete public product and live gates
concepts.evidence: Grant/revoke then compatible rollback evidence.
concepts.revisit: Build or schema compatibility changes.

concepts.name: Security
concepts.rationale: Identity and every protected data path pass negative authority verification.
concepts.component: Complete public product and live gates
concepts.evidence: Real provider and endpoint threat evidence.
concepts.revisit: Trust boundary changes.

concepts.name: Error handling
concepts.rationale: Expected errors have typed safe recovery actions and no partial write.
concepts.component: Complete public product and live gates
concepts.evidence: Validation/conflict/dependency failure scenarios.
concepts.revisit: A new failure category appears.

concepts.name: Idempotency
concepts.rationale: Retries with matching scope/fingerprint return one durable outcome.
concepts.component: Complete public product and live gates
concepts.evidence: Lost response and altered fingerprint scenarios.
concepts.revisit: Unsafe command or delivery path changes.

concepts.name: Timeout
concepts.rationale: Requests, locks and external work honor an explicit end to end budget.
concepts.component: Complete public product and live gates
concepts.evidence: Stalled dependency and lock deadline evidence.
concepts.revisit: Measured latency or dependency behavior changes.

concepts.name: Controlled retry
concepts.rationale: Transient retry is bounded and never starts a new unsafe operation identity.
concepts.component: Complete public product and live gates
concepts.evidence: Attempt/deadline bounds and no duplicate effect.
concepts.revisit: Failure classification changes.

concepts.name: Minimum documentation
concepts.rationale: Product, contracts, runbook, limitations and evidence match the released revision.
concepts.component: Complete public product and live gates
concepts.evidence: Doc links and command/behavior audit.
concepts.revisit: A release changes supported behavior.

concepts.name: Ownership
concepts.rationale: Each invariant, service signal, exception and gate has an accountable role.
concepts.component: Complete public product and live gates
concepts.evidence: No unowned release blocker or alert.
concepts.revisit: Team or operating responsibility changes.

concepts.name: Monitoring
concepts.rationale: Dashboards and alert drills detect scoped failure before cohort expansion.
concepts.component: Complete public product and live gates
concepts.evidence: Synthetic mismatch stops rollout and reaches the operator.
concepts.revisit: A real incident escapes current detection.

concepts.name: Scale plan
concepts.rationale: Document budgets and measured revisit triggers rather than speculative infrastructure.
concepts.component: Complete public product and live gates
concepts.evidence: Capacity/growth worksheet with safe limits.
concepts.revisit: Traffic or data exceeds a reviewed assumption.

concepts.name: Failure plan
concepts.rationale: Define safe denial, isolation, recovery and repair forward for partial failures.
concepts.component: Complete public product and live gates
concepts.evidence: Provider, database, delivery and restore drills.
concepts.revisit: A new dependency or irreversible operation appears.

concepts.name: Simplicity
concepts.rationale: Remove work without accepted value while preserving correctness and recovery evidence.
concepts.component: Complete public product and live gates
concepts.evidence: Review identifies the smallest complete implementation.
concepts.revisit: Optional work consumes critical verification capacity.
